scope: Local synthetic evidence reconciliation and proposed PG17 adoption; no normative application, S11, publication or task closure

criteria.expected: The sealed 48-file bootstrap independent package remains byte-exact, including all historical FAILs.
Current r3, Constitution, approved specs, contracts, migrations and application behavior remain unchanged; r4 is explicitly a separate unapproved proposal.

The r4 proposal isolates bootstrap identity preservation via supported initdb and an exact single CREATE ROLE substitution asserted against OID10 and the original name; it does not omit other statements or suppress errors.

r4 describes original and transformed protected hashes, reversible reconstruction, clean exclusive target, exact roles/attributes/grantors/options and security equivalence; it does not generalize an unsupported catalog edit or privilege grant.
The t1 witness is a preserved independent source with traceable digest and operation/effect/part/attempt identity; mere time/amount similarity is insufficient.
C04/B07 may conserve manual evidence and its scoped links with source, occurrence and recording times, actor, coverage and certainty; a reviewed evidence record does not alone imply B08 success.
A t1 attempt absent in restored Core remains absent. No synthetic reconstruction via claim/start, direct SQL row insertion, substituted attempt or false HA transition is allowed.
The missing-attempt result call is rejected by the existing contract without mutating B08 attempts, parts, reservations or producing another provider effect.

A technical diagnostic references only an existing authorized execution/context; an absent operation remains unverified_attempt. It never becomes original business evidence or proves a missing attempt.

If registering a communication fact, use the existing exact original communication/evidence/context and applicable review/version/party guards; a generic work result cannot be mislabeled a communication fact.
An existing uncertain attempt remains uncertain without reliable authorized exact observation; timeout, lease expiry and manual permission cannot prove no prior effect.

An existing uncertain attempt may reconcile only with exact executionId, attemptId, outcome and resultRef from the trusted simulated provider and an existing contacted reservation; history appends to the original attempt.
Reconciliation preserves execution suspension, generation fencing, approval identity, attempt count and provider contact/effect counts. No resume, start, S11 or reserve/release shortcut occurs.

Absent/mismatched/uncertain provider observations and unauthorized actors do not produce success or mutate protected state; expected errors are classified and positive liveness controls exclude transport failures.
Exact replay is idempotent; changed result or mismatched original identity is rejected or creates the existing review conflict, never silently overwrites historical success.
Post-reconciliation comparisons classify exact mutable changes and preserve immutable historical rows, approved material, previous claims, role/ACL authority and other resources.
New local resources use protected copies, synthetic identities and network isolation; temporary originals and former custody remain intact; outputs exclude raw secrets and private payloads.
Every new observed result maps to a frozen expected and actual instrument/source hash; historical FAILs remain readable and false earlier success claims remain explicitly invalidated.
AC-073 coverage distinguishes preservation of t1 evidence, reconciliation of existing uncertainty and unresolved missing-attempt application. AC-074 is not broadened by an unrelated evidence test.
H6-015 stays IN PROGRESS with a proposed acceptance candidate only; ARCH-PENDING-002 and DM-PENDING-005 stay OPEN. No S11, Production, real effects, publication or normative approval is inferred.
